title: StudyLabCanonicalSchemaIndex
description: Consolidated schema index for StudyLab Content Authoring and APKG generation.

semantic_learning_ir.description: Canonical schema for medium-neutral, typed Semantic Learning Intermediate Representation (IR).

apkg_anchor.description: Embedded payload in Anki notes defining procedural schema, inline contract, or content reference.

rich_content_contract.description: Complete declarative specification for problem families, archetypes, parameter domains, constraints, and step nodes.

practice_item.description: Canonical data model for ingested PYQs, curated items, and synthetic practice instances.

pattern_archetype.description: Problem pattern taxonomy, recognition signals, and PYQ references.

solution_graph.description: Directed acyclic graph of problem solution steps, 32 step types, and 3-tier hints.

domain_evidence.description: Cognitive diagnostic evidence payload routed from reviewer to adaptive remediation policy.

provenance.description: Exam source grounding, shift/year metadata, and generator versioning.

validation_contract.description: Exhaustive limits, bounds, and arithmetic safety invariants.

topic_capability_map.description: Complete map of 175 target topics across 4 domains.

legacy_difficulty_hint.description: Old field found in legacy docs; silently ignored by engine. Must use difficulty_override.

runtime_only_skill_state.description: Learner history, SkillState, FSRS parameters, and RemediationQueue are strictly runtime-managed and must NEVER be embedded in authoring datasets or APKGs.
